The Roubic Orange Story

A Heritage Canopy Worth Keeping

Orange has been part of Roubic's rotation for over three decades. The trees that make Orange look like Orange — heritage oaks, mature maples, original-growth pines, and ash carrying EAB risk — are exactly the trees our crew works on. Family-owned since 1982, Roubic knows which streets the village allows access on and which lots carry tree-protection considerations.

Orange sits right next to Pepper Pike, Moreland Hills, and Beachwood, and many Orange homeowners first hear about us through a neighbor's referral. It's estate-property character on slightly tighter lots — specimen trees, insurance-documented work, and crews that leave the landscaping untouched. That's a fit with how Roubic operates: owner-supervised jobs, ANSI A300 pruning standards, and a full owned equipment fleet.

The tree care has to fit the place. In Orange that means respecting a mature canopy that took decades to grow — I still walk the estimates myself. {{global.owner_name}} · Owner

Permit coordination included. Orange follows standard Cuyahoga County rules on private property; when a removal or ROW job needs village sign-off, Roubic handles the paperwork as part of the estimate scope.

Common Orange Questions

Orange Tree Service FAQ

Six things Orange homeowners want to know before booking.

Do you serve Orange, OH?
Yes — Orange is part of Roubic's Tier 2 service area, about 8 miles from our Auburn Township yard, and we've worked the village since 1982. Call {{global.phone}} for a free on-site estimate.
How quickly can Roubic respond in Orange?
Tier 2 markets like Orange get next-day response on standard scheduled work and a 2–4 hour target on emergencies from our Auburn Township yard. For storm emergencies, our 24/7 line is answered directly and the crew dispatches straight away.
Do I need a tree-removal permit in Orange?
Generally no — Orange follows standard Cuyahoga County rules for tree removal on private property. Large-scale clearing can trigger zoning review, and commercial or ROW work coordinates with village engineering. Roubic confirms permit requirements and handles any coordination as part of every estimate.
How much does tree removal cost in Orange?
Tree removal in Orange typically runs $200–$10,000+ depending on size, species, access, and any permit fees. Small trees under 20 ft start around $200–$500; mature 50–80 ft trees run $1,500–$3,500; very large heritage estate trees needing crane assistance can exceed $10,000. Every job is quoted free on-site before work begins.
Are you insured to work in Orange?
Yes — Roubic carries general liability and workers-comp insurance. A certificate of insurance is available on request and included in the estimate packet for jobs that require COI submission.
How do I schedule a free estimate for my Orange property?
Click any Get a Free Estimate button on this page and send your Orange address, the service you need, and a phone number — or call {{global.phone}}. Aaron responds within one business day to confirm and schedule the on-site visit.
